comment.comment:
I have so much conviction in $Rings that I will not post another thesis until next week.

Those who need to be shaken out will be & by then the chart will consist of those who see the vision.

If your hand needs to be held then fine.

I’ve hit multiple generational trades & 100x’s,

The period of uncertainty just before “luck” flows your way is exactly why it is a generational trade.

The invisible force that I talk about isn’t supposed to make everyone rich, it simply rewards those who believes it exists.

If you lack conviction or simply can’t handle the red then don’t expect to ever hit a 100x-1000x trade & retire because if you do it will be pure luck and most likely you made it fast so it will leave your hands that exact same way.

I have more experience than most & it’s simple,

Whatever your feeling now, just imagine $Rings is at 100k mcap

How would you feel?

Me personally, I would say wow this was a generational project that ticked all the boxes, 100k is cheap.

Now imagine $Rings is at 100M

How would you feel?

Me personally, I would say it’s a generational project it makes sense to be here.

So the thing is,

Have a thesis & trust it.

Because on my 100x trades and I’m talking 2M to 300m mcap trades, so actual size.

My thesis made sense but how it played out was almost always different to how I expected with either the timeline of events or what exactly caused the spike.

So you don’t have to predict every move, understand why you bought & why you continued to hold.

If you sell simply because the chart turned red, I’m sorry to tell you but you really aren’t a good trader at all.

A great trade consists of seeing the energy before it arrives.

My thesis remains intact.

100M-1B within 90 days & nothing less.
